title: How to Cancel ClassPass NZ — Step-by-Step Guide 2026
meta_desc: How to cancel your ClassPass membership in New Zealand. Exact steps, notice periods, your Consumer Law rights, and a copy-paste cancellation email template.
intro: Cancelling your ClassPass membership in New Zealand is straightforward if you follow the right steps. The most important rule: always give written notice and get written confirmation back. This guide gives you the exact process, your legal rights under NZ Consumer Law, and a ready-to-send cancellation email.

sections.heading: ClassPass NZ — Cancellation Facts at a Glance

sections.heading: Step 1 — Find Your Contract End Date
sections.body: Before doing anything else, locate your original membership agreement and confirm your contract end date. For ClassPass, the minimum term is Monthly subscription — cancel any time. If you're unsure, call or visit your home club and ask — they are required to tell you. Write the date down before contacting them.

sections.heading: Step 2 — Give Written Notice
sections.body: ClassPass can be cancelled entirely online through the ClassPass app or website. Go to Account → Manage Membership → Cancel Membership. No phone calls, no in-person visits required. Send your notice with enough lead time to cover the notice period of Cancel at any time before your next billing date. Your notice period starts from the date the gym receives your notice — not when you send it. Always use email so you have a timestamp and a record.

sections.heading: Step 3 — Use This Cancellation Email Template
sections.body:
Copy and paste this template. Fill in the [brackets].

Subject: ClassPass Account Cancellation Request To: support@classpass.com (or use in-app support chat) Hi ClassPass support, I am requesting cancellation of my ClassPass subscription. Account email: [Your email address] Country: New Zealand Requested cancellation date: [Today's date] Please confirm my account has been cancelled and that no further charges will be made after [date]. Thank you, [Your name]

sections.heading: Step 4 — Get Written Confirmation
sections.body: Do not consider your cancellation complete until ClassPass confirms it in writing. Reply to ask for confirmation if you don't receive it within 3 business days. If the club is unresponsive, escalate in writing to ClassPass's national customer service team. Keep every email.

sections.heading: Step 5 — Cancel Your Direct Debit (At the Right Time)
sections.body: Only cancel your bank direct debit after you have received written confirmation from ClassPass that your membership has ended. Cancelling before this point is treated as non-payment. ClassPass charges monthly to your card. Cancellation through the app stops future charges immediately. Your membership continues until the end of the current billing period.

sections.heading: Your Rights Under NZ Consumer Law
sections.body:
ClassPass is a US company operating under NZ Consumer Law for NZ subscribers. As a monthly digital subscription, you have the right to cancel at any time. Unused credits are non-refundable under standard terms, but if ClassPass has failed to deliver a service you paid for (studio closed, class cancelled), you may request a refund or credit.

The NZ Commerce Commission has guidance on unfair contract terms — gym contracts that automatically roll over without clear notice, or that charge excessive cancellation fees, may fall foul of the Fair Trading Act 1986. If you believe you're being charged unfairly, contact the Commerce Commission or lodge a dispute with the Disputes Tribunal (free to use for claims under $30,000).

sections.heading: Common Problems and How to Handle Them
list: Subscription auto-renewed before you cancelled — ClassPass sends renewal reminders by email. If you missed it and were charged, contact ClassPass support within 48 hours and request a refund for the unused period.

Can't find the cancel button — in the app: tap your profile icon → Settings → Membership → Cancel. On desktop: Account → Membership Plan → Cancel plan. If it's not showing, your account may be on a promotional or gift plan with different terms.
Credits disappeared after cancellation — unused ClassPass credits expire at the end of your billing period when you cancel. Use them before cancelling or roll to a lower-credit plan first.
Studios showing as unavailable — some studios are removed from ClassPass periodically. This doesn't entitle you to a refund but you can contact support to request a plan adjustment.

faq.q: Can I cancel ClassPass NZ online?
faq.a: ClassPass can be cancelled entirely online through the ClassPass app or website. Go to Account → Manage Membership → Cancel Membership. No phone calls, no in-person visits required. Most ClassPass NZ locations do not offer online cancellation — you need to notify your home club directly.

faq.q: What happens if I cancel my ClassPass direct debit without notifying the gym?
faq.a: Never cancel your direct debit before getting written confirmation of cancellation from ClassPass. Doing so counts as non-payment and may result in debt collection action, even if you've stopped attending. Always cancel the debit only after the gym confirms your membership has ended.

faq.q: Can I freeze my ClassPass membership instead of cancelling?
faq.a: Most ClassPass locations offer membership freezes for medical or travel reasons. A freeze typically costs $5–$10/week and suspends your access without cancelling. Ask your home club about freeze terms before committing to a full cancellation.

faq.q: What are my rights under the NZ Consumer Law when cancelling ClassPass?
faq.a: ClassPass is a US company operating under NZ Consumer Law for NZ subscribers. As a monthly digital subscription, you have the right to cancel at any time. Unused credits are non-refundable under standard terms, but if ClassPass has failed to deliver a service you paid for (studio closed, class cancelled), you may request a refund or credit.

faq.q: Can I pause ClassPass instead of cancelling?
faq.a: Yes — ClassPass offers a 'pause' feature that suspends your subscription for 1–3 months. During a pause, no credits accrue and no charges occur. Find it in Account → Manage Membership. This is better than cancelling if you're taking a temporary break.

faq.q: What happens to my ClassPass credits when I cancel?
faq.a: Credits expire at the end of your current billing period when you cancel. Any rollover credits from previous months also expire. Use all credits before your membership ends. There is no cash refund for unused credits under standard terms.

faq.q: I cancelled but was still charged — what do I do?
faq.a: Contact ClassPass support immediately with your cancellation confirmation. If they don't resolve it within 5 business days, contact your bank or credit card company to dispute the charge. Keep your cancellation confirmation email as evidence.
